name: research-skills
description: AI/ML precedent investigation, problem decomposition, result interpretation, cue recombination, hypothesis development, and iterative research, with independent records, pilots, reports, mirrors, and GPU execution.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-led AI/ML inquiry and research operations
interface.longDescription: Six reasoning skills for investigating precedents, decomposing problems, interpreting results, recombining research cues, developing provisional hypotheses, and advancing an inquiry through evidence-led iterations. Independent skills manage persistent experiment records, representative pilots, research reports, requested Notion mirrors, and repository-scoped shared-uv GPU execution.
defaultPrompt: Investigate research cues and choose an informative next attempt within this inquiry's scope.
Develop a provisional hypothesis from the available evidence and expose its assumptions.
Analyze existing research results and state what remains unexplained.
Manage a requested persistent experiment record or plan representative new-evidence execution.
Inspect this repository's shared uv environment and the GPUs allocated on this server.
